TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "body composition improvement with glycemic control"

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Full-body foundation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds

          chest_stretch 60 seconds

          walking 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          running 15 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioning + Core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          crunch 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          planks 3x30s rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Build A":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 20m "Fasted Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioning & Core":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Build B":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_fpress 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 20m "Fasted Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioning & Core":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Hypertrophy Build A Repeat":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 20m "Fasted Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x20..30
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull + Core":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_fly 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45s
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):

      DAY Monday training 60m "Neuromuscular Focus - intensified Push":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 5x3..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Conditioning Intervals":
        warmup:
          jogging_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          rower 8 rounds: 30s high intensity, 60s easy
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Push/Pull Strength":
        warmup:
          rower 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          military_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Tempo & Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 4x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Tuesday training 20m "Fasted Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cycling 15 minutes rpe 6
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 2 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x20..30
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
      DAY Friday training 60m "Full-body maintenance - Push emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds

NUTRITION AND DIABETES SPECIFIC GUIDANCE
  - Calorie target: create a modest deficit of 500 kcal/day from maintenance, adjustable to 300–750 kcal based on weekly weight Change (aim 0.5–1 kg/week). Monitor via weekly weight trend.
  - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight per day to preserve lean mass and support glycemic control. Distribute evenly across 3–5 meals.
  - Carbohydrate strategy:
    - Target ~25–35 g total carbohydrate per main meal in early weeks for glucose stability; adjust to individual response.
    - Emphasize high-fiber sources: vegetables, whole grains, legumes, and fruits with lower glycemic load.
    - Consider timing:
      - Post-exercise carbohydrate: include a moderate amount within 1–2 hours after workouts to support recovery and glycemic stability.
      - Pre-workout carbs: small portion if training in the morning; otherwise align with activity.
  - Fat: remaining calories to fat, prioritizing monounsaturated and polyunsaturated fats; minimum 0.8 g/kg/day if possible.
  - Fiber: target 25–35 g/day.
  - Sodium: moderate intake to support blood pressure; hydration adequate.
  - Hydration: water throughout the day; limit sugary beverages.
  - Alcohol: minimize; if consumed, do so with meals and monitor effect on glucose.
  - Metformin considerations:
    - Take with meals to reduce GI upset; stay hydrated.
  - Blood glucose monitoring:
    - Recommend fasting glucose daily; postprandial checks 1–2 hours after meals for traceable patterns.
    - Maintain a simple log; share with care team if significant variability (>30 mg/dL) or persistent hyperglycemia.
  - Intermittent fasting considerations (IF) integrated where appropriate:
    - If using IF, ensure eating window includes adequate protein and fiber; place post-workout nutrition inside window.
  - Cheat meals:
    - If weekly cheat meal is desired, plan within the 12-week plan as a controlled discretionary meal, ideally 1 per week, not during high-volume training days; attempt to revert to planned nutrition promptly afterwards and monitor glucose response.
  - Safety:
    - Avoid highly processed, sugary foods that spike glucose.
    - Prioritize whole foods, consistent meals to reduce glycemic excursions.
  - Training-day nutrition plan quick example day:
    - On gym days, include 20–40 g protein within 1 hour post-workout.
    - Carbs: 20–40 g post-workout if performance requires; otherwise keep carbs moderate and fiber-rich throughout day.
  - Progress tracking:
    - Weekly weight and waist circumference.
    - Body composition monthly if possible.
    - Track energy, mood, and training performance as indirect glycemic markers.

NOTES
  - All exercises use canonical vocab; no substitutions beyond safe alternatives if needed.
  - If any contraindicated exercise arises for the client due to any condition, substitute with safer alternative from list (e.g., replace high-impact variants with low-impact equivalents).
  - Adjust volume and intensity by tolerance; priority is safety, adherence, and steady progress.
